QUOTE: "`scripts/generate_errors.pl` does the work. It scans every header for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_… -0x…` with a `/**` comment before it or `/**<` after it, groups the entries by module, and writes `library/error.c` from `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/error.c is generated from the headers by scripts/generate_errors.pl using scripts/data_files/error.fmt as the template.
